## About
Royal Used Auto Parts is on Martin Street in Rahway, stocking used and recycled OEM parts for personal and business vehicles. New arrivals come in daily, and if we don't have what you need on the shelf, our nationwide parts locating service can help track it down.
There's always a mechanic on hand to answer your parts questions, and our sales staff is here to help you find the right part. Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 302 Google reviews, and reviewers mention helpful service over the phone and easy payment with Zelle.

## Services
- Recycled OEM car parts: Recycled OEM car parts for personal and business vehicles, with new arrivals coming in daily.
- Nationwide parts locating: If we don't have the part you need, we can search for it nationwide.
- Engines and transmissions: In-stock engines and transmissions come with a limited 90 day warranty. Ask us about the terms.

## FAQ
Q: Do your engines and transmissions come with a warranty?
A: Yes. In-stock engines and transmissions come with a limited 90 day warranty. Ask us for the details before you buy.

Q: Can someone help me figure out which part I need?
A: Yes. We always have a mechanic on hand to answer your auto parts questions.

Q: Can I pay with Zelle?
A: Customers have told us paying with Zelle was quick and easy. Give us a call and we'll walk you through it.
